name: 46. Reasoning × Tool-Call Multi-Turn Interleave (criss-cross)
description:
Three-turn conversations that interleave reasoning with tool calls, replayed across every request shape.

Each chain runs the same conversation: turn 1 reasons and calls `get_weather`; turn 2 replays that assistant turn (thinking/reasoning block intact) plus the tool result and asks for `get_flight_time`; turn 3 replays the whole history - two assistant turns of reasoning and up to two tool results - and asks for a final answer. What is under test is that Bifrost carries reasoning blocks and their signatures back to the provider unmodified through a tool round-trip, twice. Folders 19/20/38/39/42-45 each cover a single reasoning replay; none of them interleaves tool calls across three turns.

`tool_choice` is left on auto for the Anthropic-family chains rather than forcing `get_weather`. Forced tool choice is rejected with manual extended thinking (`thinking.type: enabled`) and only supported under adaptive thinking (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-tool-workflows), and Bedrock adds its own constraints on the pairing - keeping tool_choice unset makes one conversation valid on every surface. Turn 1 asserts a tool call came back, so a model that ignores the prompt fails loudly instead of letting turns 2 and 3 skip silently.

exec: pm.test('turn 1 returns a tool_use to build the interleave on', function () {
pm.expect(kinds, 'no tool_use came back, so turns 2 and 3 would skip and this chain would pass having tested nothing').to.include('tool_use');
// A thinking block is only asserted when one is present: adaptive thinking
// decides per request whether to think. What is always asserted is that a
// thinking block which IS returned carries the signature the replay needs.
pm.expect(b.signature, 'a thinking block came back without a signature, so it cannot be replayed on the next turn').to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty;
// Every tool call has to be answered, not just the first one. Current models
// emit parallel calls, and a history that replays a call without its output is
// rejected outright - OpenAI answers "No tool output found for function call
// <id>", Anthropic and Bedrock require a tool_result per tool_use. Answering
// only calls[0] made these rows flake whenever the model parallelized.

var messages = [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: "Plan a trip for me, thinking it through before you act. First, what is the weather in Tokyo right now? Use the get_weather tool." }] },
{ role: 'user', content: uses.map(function (u) { return { type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: u.id, content: stubOutput46(u.name) }; })
.concat([{ type: 'text', text: "Given that weather, how long is the flight from SFO to Tokyo? Use the get_flight_time tool, and think about whether the rain changes the plan." }]) }];
